wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 08-001 bridges the IwadResourceCache (05-001) + wad buffer + a map name into a frozen runtime MapData snapshot via the read-only P_SetupLevel pipeline (src/map/mapSetup.ts setupLevel + src/map/mapBundle.ts parseMapBundle). The wrapper validates the map name and propagates parser errors verbatim. The returned MapData contains the full P_GroupLines outputs: per-sector line lists, bounding boxes, sound origins, sub-sector to sector lookup, line front/back resolution, and the validCount tracker — everything downstream world/AI/render lanes consume at level load.
publicSurface: wireLevelSetup(resourceCache: IwadResourceCache, wadBuffer: Buffer, mapName: string): MapData
